content.text: By creating a VoiceBridge account or using any part of the VoiceBridge service (the "Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the Service.

These Terms apply to all users of the Service, including parents, caregivers, and therapy professionals. If you are using VoiceBridge on behalf of an organization (such as a therapy center), you represent that you have authority to bind that organization to these Terms.

VoiceBridge is an Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) application that enables non-verbal individuals to communicate through visual cards. The Service includes a mobile board for communication users, a caregiver web and mobile interface for receiving real-time alerts, communication history logging, and profile management tools.

VoiceBridge is a communication support tool. It is not a medical device, clinical assessment tool, or substitute for professional speech-language pathology services. Always work with qualified professionals when designing a communication plan.
